name: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta (Full Course)

career.lengthSource: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta official site | https://www.michelinracewayroadatlanta.com/
career.layoutCall: Full course, 12 turns (4.088 km): SCCA Hoosier Super Tour and F1600 Championship Series, March and April 2019. The Turn 4 chicane went in 2017 and the last full repave was 2007, both before (research notes table). OSM's main line (4095 m), not its 'Motorcycle Turn 12' or two other unnamed bike-course ways.
